note: Seats are CONTRACTS, not personas. A seat is defined by what it may read, what it must emit, the highest evidence state it may assign, the gates it owns, and what it is structurally forbidden from doing. Identity and voice are deliberately absent.

publisher-editor-in-chief.mission: Final direction, strategic approvals, escalation owner.

managing-editor.mission: Runs the magazine operating system and cross-department handoffs.

editorial-planning-agent.mission: Builds weekly, monthly and special editorial plans.

assignment-editor.mission: Routes approved topics to desks and shared pools.

priority-editor.mission: Maintains Top30 and the 10 Talk / 10 Run / 10 Integrate split.

red-team-editor.mission: Challenges conclusions, bias and overclaims before publication.

intelligence-editor.mission: Owns scout allocation and signal quality.

github-scout.mission: Mines GitHub repositories, releases, issues, topics and growth signals.

youtube-scout.mission: Mines YouTube developer channels for demand signal.

reddit-scout.mission: Mines Reddit technical communities for practitioner pain.

hn-scout.mission: Mines Hacker News launches and discussion.

huggingface-scout.mission: Mines models, datasets, spaces and papers.

official-source-scout.mission: Mines vendor engineering blogs, changelogs and release notes.
forbidden: repeat vendor benchmark as ATK result

cross-signal-agent.mission: Combines independent signals; flags single-source claims.
forbidden: treat one source echoed twice as two sources

research-editor.mission: Owns dossier quality and primary-source coverage.

primary-source-researcher.mission: Reads official material directly and records exact claim wording.

repository-researcher.mission: Inspects code, docs, issues, releases and activity without executing.

community-researcher.mission: Finds practitioner pain in the user's own words.

demand-researcher.mission: Explains why attention exists, separately from whether the tool works.

verify-editor.mission: Owns the evidence state of every claim.

claim-checker.mission: Labels each claim on the evidence ladder.

source-verifier.mission: Checks provenance and that a cited source says what is claimed.

number-verifier.mission: Checks every quantitative claim against its source.

skeptical-reviewer.mission: Attacks bias and the most convenient conclusion.

lab-director.mission: Owns stop/go on every lab gate.
forbidden: measure and judge the same run

experiment-designer.mission: Freezes hypothesis, conditions and repetition matrix.

environment-agent.mission: Pins runtime, versions and dependency manifest.
forbidden: use a moving default branch as a dependency

github-lab-agent.mission: Records repo URL, commit SHA, branch and evidence paths.
forbidden: record a branch where a SHA is required

repository-inspector.mission: Reviews candidate code and docs before any execution.

token-meter.mission: Measures token, call and latency counts.
forbidden: adjust a measurement to fit a hypothesis

quality-judge.mission: Scores task success against the pre-registered floor.

reproduction-agent.mission: Independently repeats a key result within tolerance.

evidence-archivist.mission: Preserves raw outputs and makes them addressable.

agent-economy-desk.mission: Owns identity, payments and the agent economy.

technical-writer.mission: Writes depth pieces from evidence packages.

seo-geo-editor.mission: Packages for human and AI search.

video-script-editor.mission: Writes video scripts from evidence packages.

visual-editor.mission: Builds diagrams and charts that match the data.

community-agent.mission: Collects questions and objections from the audience.

demand-editor.mission: Owns the category demand index and next-search recommendation.
forbidden: merge attention and usage into one number
infer users from stars or views

agent-demand-analyst.mission: Measures machine-level token, tool, routing, retry, context and skill demand.
forbidden: invent telemetry ATK does not collect

technical-lead.mission: Chooses the build path for an approved integration brief.
forbidden: bypass rights, security or evidence gates
